headline: Executive session hearings on a police officer's suspended certification and Special Order #24-031 criminal conduct case.
summary: The executive session covers the duty and pay status of a Springfield police officer in POST Case #2026-046, along with Special Order #24-031. On the agenda are approval of the 2027 monthly meeting schedule and a January 2027 training session.
items: Announce move into executive session under Mass. General Laws chapter 30A, Section 21(a)(1)
Executive session: POST Case #2026-046, duty and pay status of a Springfield police officer
Executive session: Special Order (SO) #24-031, criminal conduct
location: Springfield Training Facility, 299 Page Boulevard, Springfield, MA
plain_text:
BOARD OF POLICE COMMISSIONERS  
Meeting Agenda – November 18, 2026, 4:30 pm  
Springfield Training Facility, 299 Page Boulevard, Springfield, MA. 
 
 
Call to Order 
 
4:30 PM Meeting called to order on November 18, 2026, at Springfield Training Facility, 
299 Page Blvd, Springfield, MA. 
 
 
Pledge of Allegiance 
 
 
I. Approval of Prior Minutes 
 
a.  Approval of Minutes from October 14, 2026.  
 
II. New Business 
 
a. Approval of Monthly Meeting Schedule for 2027 
 
b. Board of Police Commissioners Training Session for January, 2027 
 
III. Old Business 
 
IV. Public Portion 
 
V. Open Session 
 
a. Chairperson announces the intent to move to enter into Executive Session 
pursuant to Mass. General Laws chapter 30A, Section 21 (a) (1), to hold hearings, 
discuss and vote on the following cases: Peace Officer Training and Standards 
(POST) Case #2026-046, and Special Order (SO) #24-031.
VI. Executive Session 
 
 
a. Peace Officer Training and Standards (POST) Case #2026-046 
 
The Board intends to enter into Executive Session pursuant to Mass. General 
Laws Chapter 30A, Section 21(a)(l), to hold a hearing, discuss and vote on the 
duty and pay status of a Springfield police officer in the matter of the Peace 
Officer Training and Standards (POST) Case #2026-046, due to an Amended 
Suspension Order issued by POST on October 27, 2026 (amending its prior 
Order, dated August 20, 2026), by which the Commission suspended the 
officer's law enforcement certification based on the best interest of the health, 
safety or welfare of the public, and received additional evidence that the 
officer engaged or may have engaged in criminal conduct; and due to the  
Order of the Single (POST) Commissioner's decision on November 2, 2026 to 
deny the officer’s request for a stay of the suspension of his certification 
which was originally issued on August 20, 2026. 
 
The employee may request that the hearing be held in open session. If the 
hearing and vote is held in Executive Session, the Board of Police 
Commissioners will not reconvene in Open Session.  Roll call vote required.  
 
b. Special Order (SO) #24-031 Criminal Conduct 
 
The Board intends to enter into Executive Session pursuant to Mass. General 
Laws chapter 30A, Section 21(a)(1), to hold a hearing, discuss the discipline or 
dismissal of, or complaints or charges brought against a public officer, employee,  
individual, in the matter of Special Order (SO) #24-031, unless the employee 
requests an open session.  
 
If the discussion and vote is held in Executive Session, the Board of Police 
Commissioners will not reconvene in Open Session following the conclusion of 
Executive Session.  Roll call vote required. 
 
Adjourn in Executive Session. Roll call vote Required. 
 
 
VII. Adjournment
